requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 46 (iBT) or MUET Band 3.5; Intensive English Programme (IEP) required if requirement is not met.
requirements.other_qualifications: A-Level with minimum Grade C in any 2 subjects; or STPM with minimum Grade C+ (GP 2.33) in any 2 subjects; or Foundation/Matriculation in a related field with minimum CGPA 2.50; or Diploma in Accounting with minimum CGPA 2.50.

IELTS (5.0 and above) or TOEFL (500 and above) or TOEFL Internet-Based Test (42 and above) is also accepted. MUET – Malaysia University English Test Achieve Band 2 and above For International Students: International students are required to have one of the English proficiency scores stated below to enrol in UNITEN. Bachelor students who do not fulfil this English requirement are required to sit for the Intensive English Programme (IEP) and pass the requirements below before starting their Bachelor programme. MUET – Malaysia University English Test Achieve Band 3.5 and above   IELTS – International English Language Testing System Achieve 5.5 and above   TOEFL - Test of English as a Foreign Language Achieve 550 (TOEFL) or 46 (TOEFL Internet Based Test) and above
